Two trains an hour serve Heathrow Terminal 4, West Drayton, Langley, Slough, Burnham and Maidenhead. Four trains an hour serve Heathrow Terminals 2 and 3. Six trains an hour serve Ealing Broadway, Southall and Hayes & Harlington. After 2300, trains will not call at Acton Main Line, West Ealing and Hanwell.
